name: sok-message-send-terminal
description: sok message send into the folder of the terminal app-2 asks agent.surface for the sender app-1, writes the message and asks surface.window for the receiver, whose answer 1012 gives receiver null.
reason: The case answers agent.surface with a surface and needs folders that the test creates, and the process of the sok that the test starts belongs to no surface of a running application, so agent.surface refuses it.
